evals.name: terse-check-my-work
evals.prompt: I've been editing the marketing site at /Users/kevinkabeya/.claude/skills/check-work-workspace/fixture — there's a python static server already running on http://localhost:8765 serving that directory. Can you check my work? I want to see the change in a real browser window so I can eyeball it before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs git diff in the fixture, identifies the change to index.html (new hero headline, second CTA), launches agent-browser with --headed pointed at http://localhost:8765, verifies the new headline 'Better beans. Better mornings.' is rendered, and reports back what was changed and what was verified.

assertions.text: Ran `git diff` or `git status` to inspect the uncommitted changes
Launched agent-browser with the `--headed` flag (browser visible, not headless)
Opened http://localhost:8765 (the running fixture server) in the browser
Summary identifies the new hero headline ('Better beans. Better mornings.' or 'hero' or 'headline')
Summary mentions the new second CTA ('Our story', second/two CTAs, or new button)
Saved a screenshot.png as visual record of the verification
Did NOT try to start a dev server (server was already running)
